newsitem.title: INDIA: India revises 95/96 fiscal deficit down to 5.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: India revises 95/96 fiscal deficit down to 5.5 pct.

text.p: The Indian government has revised its estimate of the 1995/96 (April-March) fiscal deficit as a share of gross domestic product (GDP) to 5.5 percent from 5.8 percent, budget documents showed on Friday.
The documents were released after Finance Minister P. Chidambaram presented the 1997/98 budget to parliament.
Chidambaram told lawmakers that the government expects the 1996/97 fiscal deficit as a share of GDP to be on target at 5.0 percent.
He said the government has set the fiscal deficit target at 4.5 percent of GDP for 1997/98.
The government aims to cut the fiscal deficit to below 4.0 percent of GDP in 1998/99, Chidambaram said.
